required_sources.implementation_note: Pilot v0.1 currently verifies only government-procurement result detail pages under /jyxxcgjg/. Tender, amendment, termination and other columns must be independently verified before this source can be marked IMPLEMENTED.

Official Tianjin procurement content is recognized across tjgp.cz.tj.gov.cn and ccgp-tianjin.gov.cn aliases. Strict documentView detail parsing is implemented, but native 2026 listing/search discovery, runtime direct-fetch confirmation and source-native attachment hrefs remain unverified.

Official tjgpc.zwfwb.tj.gov.cn detail route /webInfo/getWebInfoByPkWebInfoId1.do?pkWebInfoId=<UUID> is verified from indexed official pages and deterministic public-tender detail parsing is implemented. Search indexing also confirms the official /webInfo/downloadFile.do?fileName=...&fileUrl=... document-wrapper family. v0.1 can safely discover only the observed wrapper/origin shape, but download_authorized remains false because crawler-runtime bytes, MIME/magic/SHA and medical-project wrapper linkage are not yet validated. Native listing class ids/pagination and all procurement methods remain unverified. This is a centralized-procurement subset, not a citywide-source replacement.
